title: Gifts for a WoW player
lede: Picked by the guild for someone about to lose their evenings to WoW: Forever. Sorted by item quality: green is under $25, legendary is the one they'll tell guild chat about.
note: Prices move, so we show a range, not a number. Most links open an Amazon search, not one listing, so you can pick the seller and the edition you want.

tiers.label: Epic
tiers.blurb: Birthday or Christmas, from someone who listens.

gifts.name: Blizzard gift card
gifts.use: Adds Battle.net balance for the subscription, a mount or a name change.
gifts.why: It's the dull choice, and it's the one they'll use. Get the digital code and it can go in a card the night before.
gifts.q: Blizzard Battle.net gift card digital code

gifts.name: Arthas: Rise of the Lich King
gifts.use: Explains why everyone in Northrend is so upset.
gifts.why: Christie Golden's novel is the best of the Warcraft books and it's in paperback. Forever's road runs toward Naxxramas, so it's the right one to read this year.
gifts.q: Arthas Rise of the Lich King Christie Golden paperback

gifts.name: A World of Warcraft Funko Pop
gifts.use: Watches over the keyboard during raid night.
gifts.why: Funko's current WoW range has Jaina, Xal'atath and a few murlocs. Ask which faction they play first, or it becomes a talking point all evening.

gifts.name: Folk & Fairy Tales of Azeroth
gifts.use: Bedtime stories told the way people in Azeroth tell them.
gifts.why: A short illustrated hardback. Works for a player with kids or a kid who plays.
gifts.q: World of Warcraft Folk and Fairy Tales of Azeroth

gifts.name: An extended desk mat
gifts.use: Your mouse stops falling off the edge in the middle of a fight.
gifts.why: One that covers the whole desk is the cheapest real upgrade there is. SteelSeries makes a QcK XXL with WoW art; a plain one works just as well. Skip the RGB.
gifts.q: SteelSeries QcK XXL World of Warcraft mouse pad

gifts.name: World of Warcraft: The Official Cookbook
gifts.use: Teaches the recipes from the game, worked out for a real kitchen.
gifts.why: Chelsea Monroe-Cassel's cookbook is the gift that gets used on raid night. Spiced Wolf Meat for real.
gifts.q: World of Warcraft The Official Cookbook Monroe-Cassel

gifts.name: Exploring Azeroth: The Eastern Kingdoms
gifts.use: A guided tour of the zones Forever starts in.
gifts.why: Westfall, Duskwood and Stranglethorn, written as a travel book. There's a Kalimdor volume for Horde players.
gifts.q: World of Warcraft Exploring Azeroth Eastern Kingdoms

gifts.name: World of Warcraft Chronicle, Volume 1
gifts.use: Twenty thousand years of backstory, with art on every page.
gifts.why: Blizzard's own history of the world, as a big hardback. If they love it, volumes 2 and 3 are next year's presents.
gifts.q: World of Warcraft Chronicle Volume 1 hardcover

gifts.name: A ForTheGuild class cap
gifts.use: Lets everyone know you main a warrior, rogue, druid or hunter.
gifts.why: Made by our guild master: rope caps with original class art, made in Los Angeles, $39 in seven colours.

gifts.name: The 2004 BradyGames strategy guide
gifts.use: The book every 2004 player had open next to the keyboard.
gifts.why: It's out of print, but used copies come up on eBay all the time. Check it has the map poster inside.
gifts.q: World of Warcraft BradyGames official strategy guide 2004

gifts.name: World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King, the board game
gifts.use: Two to four players take on the Lich King together.
gifts.why: Z-Man's co-op game, built on the Pandemic system. Good for a player and a partner who doesn't play WoW.
gifts.q: World of Warcraft Wrath of the Lich King board game Z-Man

gifts.name: An MMO mouse
gifts.use: Puts twelve keybinds under your thumb.
gifts.why: The Razer Naga and the Corsair Scimitar are the usual picks. They're the biggest comfort upgrade for a game with forty buttons.
gifts.q: MMO gaming mouse 12 side buttons Razer Naga Corsair Scimitar

gifts.name: A headset with a good mic
gifts.use: The raid leader can hear your callouts, and nobody else can hear your house.
gifts.why: Wired is cheaper and never runs out of battery. Comfort matters more than surround sound for four-hour raids.
gifts.q: gaming headset noise cancelling microphone comfortable

gifts.name: World of Warcraft Chronicle, all three volumes
gifts.use: The full history, from the Titans to the present day.
gifts.why: Looks good on a shelf, and they'll come back to it every time a quest mentions someone they don't know.
gifts.q: World of Warcraft Chronicle box set volumes 1 2 3

gifts.name: A 1440p high-refresh monitor
gifts.use: Shows you the whole raid instead of a blurry crowd.
gifts.why: A 27-inch, 1440p, 144 Hz screen is the sweet spot for WoW. Get an ultrawide if they'd like more of the world on screen. WoW handles 21:9 well.

gifts.name: A stream deck
gifts.use: Buttons for mounts, macros, the stream scene and ready checks.
gifts.why: An Elgato Stream Deck turns fiddly keybinds into labelled buttons. It's great for anyone who streams or plays a class with a long macro list.
